title: 第一卷 南域篇 第21章 地灵根第一卷 南域篇 第22章 山鬼
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
那一日分别，白泽独自在山林穿行，赶路两日，有意在身上涂满薄荷汁水，掩盖身上的气息。
王氏三兄弟没有追上来，他不知道他们都被牛鬼弄死了，还是去追欧阳去了，反正无论如何，时刻做好战斗准备就好了。
即便追来又如何？真的硬拼，他的瀑布之剑未必就会输给他们。
这样一路穿行，渴饮山泉，饿餐野兔，困了，就在山林百年木上搭个木床，歇一宿。谢玄在羊皮卷上都标好了灵药所在的地点，白泽天生方向感极强，寻着地灵根所在的横山而去，一路奔劳，不必分说。
值得一提的是，两天前的夜里，他打坐修炼，终于破了苦海第四重天。
“修为提升，玄玉掌的威力也提升不少！”白泽想起那日一掌碎冷箭，尤自激动不已，看着自己漆黑的右掌，一掌拍碎比他还高的一块山石，赞叹不已。
“这玄玉掌果真了得！壁上绝学记载，此掌修炼到极致，掌色漆黑如玉，可轻松折断玄级灵器！”白泽心道，“若是半步剑仙王之涣那种程度，想必地级灵器，也能一掌硬抗。如今我修为太低，只是刚学会，已经能威胁到彼岸境修士的性命，若我跨苦海达彼岸，一掌下去，恐怕知微高手也要难受。”
横山地形特殊，冬暖夏凉，光照充足。地灵根就适合在这种环境里生长，夏天为草，吸纳天地灵气自由生长，冬天是虫，蛰伏地下，不死不枯，仍然在生长。
独山里的采药人，把地灵根多称呼为“虫草”，这等灵药，有拓人经脉，温养灵魂的妙用。
谢玄要炼制的丹药，白泽不太清楚。炼丹方面的知识，他跟谢玄十余年时间，但也没听谢玄提起过。
不过从谢玄要找的灵药来看，他要炼制的丹药，多半跟他当年两余年破苦海境有关，很可能是洗髓伐经的灵丹妙药。
“总算是到了。”白泽看着眼前莽莽横山，秀木繁阴，即使是深秋将近，也一派郁郁生机，感叹大自然的神奇伟力。
这个季节，正好是地灵根从草向虫转变的时候，是其药性最强，也最好找的时候。
因为此时，地灵根会呈现一种别样的褐红色，与周围一片苍翠的颜色格格不入。
进山之前，白泽在山下寻了一条小河，河水拐弯的地方，形成了一处一人深的水潭。多日赶路，他再次感叹拥有一只骑行灵兽的重要性，脱下衣物，跳进水潭，痛痛快快地洗去一身污泥。
“舒坦！”洗完澡，白泽收拾一番，竖起一头黑发，木簪一插，河水赫然倒映着一位翩翩少年，眉眼似星河，唇红齿白，腰间一把断剑，端是个潇洒剑侠！
抓了几尾河鱼，用仅剩的盐巴烤熟调味，填饱肚子，太阳已经偏西。
“是时候进山了。”白泽按剑，眼神有些凝重。
谢玄画的羊皮卷上记载，这地灵根，是很多灵兽的珍爱美味，所以此番进山采药，多有可能与灵兽遭遇。
若是遇到温顺的还好，怕就怕遇到羊皮卷上被谢玄标红的猫熊。

这种食草灵兽，领地意识极重。寻常灵兽，若是有人侵犯领地，可能只是出来龇牙咧嘴地咆哮两声，吓唬吓唬了事。
可这猫熊，那真是死脑筋，不追你出去个十来二十里路，绝不肯轻易罢休！
“无量天尊。”白泽大步进山，踩着一地的灯笼草，“但愿此行平遂。”
与此同时，河阳城界，马池镇，柳庄。
下午，秋风送爽。陈元方还在后山砍柴，柳灵闲来无事，一边在槐树下琢磨谢玄留下的棋局，一边思索当日谢玄谈笑间一手平松岗的那一剑。
“下剑杀人，中剑聚气，上剑凝意，至剑唯心。”柳灵手执黑子，不紧不慢地敲着石桌上的棋盘，“一剑千柳，是我目前所困的聚气，也就是道尊所说的中剑。”
十年前，无名剑侠在树下悟道的那一剑，是上剑，凝聚这以一化千的剑意。
而那一天，道尊拂袖挥出的拂柳一剑，是上剑，还是至剑？
“柳灵爷爷，你在想什么？”八岁的小彩云好奇地趴在村长院子的篱笆上，看着一身翠绿的柳灵，“元方哥哥每天都进山砍柴，白泽招呼也不打一声就走了，都没人陪我玩了，我好无聊啊。”
“小彩云，你要是觉得无聊，不如我教你一门呼吸吐纳的功夫，你有时间了，隔三差五给我摊两张葱花饼吃，怎么样？”忽然有人推开柴门，如是说道。
“咦，老神仙！？”彩云看清来人，惊了一声，伸长了脖子看谢玄背后是否有人，没有发现白泽，又有些失落地撅着粉嘟嘟的嘴巴，说：“白泽没有跟你一起回来吗？”
“他要帮我办件事，估计要到下雪的时候才能回来。”谢玄拎着酒葫芦，喝了口马池镇福来酒馆打来的绿蚁酒，说：“怎么样，要学吗？”
“呼吸吐纳有什么好学的？”小姑娘歪头询问，羊角辫一动一动的，煞是可爱。
“学好了，可以腾云驾雾。”谢玄说，“如何？”
“听起来很好玩啊！”彩云拍手，又皱了皱小鼻子，“不过，我得先问问我娘亲。她要是同意了，我就跟你学！”
“那你去问吧。”谢玄走到槐树下，柳灵已经站了起来，亲手为谢玄添了杯苦茶。
“道尊。”柳灵问，“这些天，您去哪了？”
content_en:
On the day we parted, Bai Ze walked alone through the mountains and forests for two days, deliberately smearing mint juice all over his body to cover up his scent.
The three Wang brothers did not catch up. He didn't know that they were all killed by the Niu Gui, or they went to chase Ouyang. Anyway, no matter what, just be ready for battle at all times.
So what if I chase you? If they really fight hard, his Waterfall Sword may not lose to them.
Along the way, I drank from mountain springs and ate hares. When I felt sleepy, I built a wooden bed on a century-old tree in the forest and rested for the night. Xie Xuan marked the location of the elixir on the parchment. Bai Ze was born with a strong sense of direction. He searched for the Hengshan Mountain where the earth spirit root was located, and worked hard all the way without any explanation.
It is worth mentioning that two nights ago, he meditated and practiced, and finally broke through the fourth level of the sea of ​​suffering.
"With the improvement of cultivation, the power of Xuan Jade Palm has also increased a lot!" Bai Ze recalled that day when he shattered a cold arrow with his palm, and he was very excited. He looked at his dark right palm and smashed a rock taller than him with one palm, and was filled with admiration.
"This Xuan Jade Palm is really amazing! According to the secret knowledge written on the wall, this palm has been cultivated to the extreme. The palm is as black as jade and can easily break Xuan level spiritual weapons!" Bai Ze thought in his heart, "If it is as good as the Half-Step Sword Immortal King Zhihuan, he must be able to break it." A super spiritual weapon can be resisted with just one palm. Now that my cultivation level is too low and I have just learned it, it can already threaten the lives of monks in the other side. If I cross the sea of suffering and hit the other side with one palm, I am afraid that master Zhiwei will also suffer. "
Hengshan has a special terrain, with warm winters and cool summers, and plenty of sunlight. Earth spirit roots are suitable for growing in this environment. In summer they are grass, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to grow freely, and in winter they are insects, dormant underground, immortal and still growing.
The herb collectors in Dushan often refer to the root of earth spirit as "Cordyceps". This kind of elixir has the wonderful effect of expanding people's meridians and warming the soul.
Bai Ze was not sure about the elixir that Xie Xuan wanted to refine. He had known Xie Xuan for more than ten years, but he had never heard Xie Xuan mention it.
However, judging from the elixir Xie Xuan was looking for, the elixir he wanted to refine was probably related to the fact that he had overcome the sea of ​​suffering for more than two years back then. It was probably the elixir for cleansing the marrow and cutting down the meridians.
"Finally we're here." Bai Ze looked at the vast mountains in front of him, with the beautiful trees and overcast trees. Even though late autumn was approaching, they were still full of life, and he sighed at the magical power of nature.
This season happens to be when the ground spirit root transforms from grass to insect. This is the time when its medicinal properties are strongest and best to find.
Because at this time, the ground spirit root will show a different kind of brownish red color, which is incompatible with the surrounding green color.
Before entering the mountain, Bai Ze found a small river at the foot of the mountain. Where the river turned, a pool was formed that was deep for one person. After many days of traveling, he once again lamented the importance of owning a riding spirit beast. He took off his clothes, jumped into the pool, and washed away the mud.
"Comfortable!" After taking a bath, Bai Ze tidied up, put his black hair up, and inserted a wooden hairpin. The river water reflected a handsome young man with eyebrows like stars, red lips and white teeth, and a broken sword at his waist. He looked like a dashing swordsman!
I caught a few river fish, roasted them with the remaining salt and seasoned them to fill my stomach. The sun was already heading west.
"It's time to enter the mountain." Bai Ze pressed his sword, his eyes a little solemn.
The parchment scroll painted by Xie Xuan records that this earth spirit root is a treasured delicacy of many spirit beasts, so there is a high chance of encountering spirit beasts when going to the mountains to collect herbs.
It would be fine if I met a docile one, but I was afraid of meeting a panda marked red by Xie Xuan on the parchment.
This herbivorous spirit beast has a strong sense of territory. Ordinary spiritual beasts, if someone invades their territory, may just come out and bar their teeth and roar twice to scare them away.
But this panda is really stubborn. He will not give up easily until he chases you for ten to twenty miles!
"Infinite Heavenly Lord." Bai Ze strode into the mountain, stepping on the lantern grass on the ground, "I hope this trip goes well."
At the same time, the city limits of Heyang, Machi Town, and Liuzhuang.
DownIn the afternoon, the autumn breeze brings coolness. Chen Yuanfang was still chopping firewood in the back mountain, and Liu Ling had nothing to do. He was pondering the chess game left by Xie Xuan under the locust tree, and thinking about the sword that Xie Xuan used to level Songgang that day while talking and laughing.
"The lower sword kills, the middle sword gathers Qi, the upper sword condenses the mind, and the ultimate sword is the heart." Liu Ling held the black piece in his hand and tapped the chessboard on the stone table slowly, "A sword with a thousand willows is the accumulated Qi I am currently trapped in, which is what Tao Zun calls the middle sword."
Ten years ago, the sword with which the unknown swordsman attained enlightenment under a tree was the upper sword, condensing the sword intention of turning one into a thousand.
And that day, Taoist Master waved the Fuliu sword with a flick of his sleeve. Was it the upper sword or the ultimate sword?
"Grandpa Liu Ling, what are you thinking about?" Eight-year-old Xiao Caiyun was lying on the fence of the village chief's yard curiously, looking at Liu Ling, who was dressed in green. "Brother Yuan Fang goes into the mountains to cut firewood every day, and Bai Ze leaves without even saying hello. No one is here to play with me anymore. I'm so bored."
"Xiao Caiyun, if you feel bored, how about I teach you the art of breathing and exhaling. Now that you have time, how about spreading out two green onion pancakes for me to eat every now and then?" Someone suddenly pushed open the firewood door and said.
"Hey, old god!?" Caiyun was startled when he saw the person coming clearly. He stretched his neck to see if there was anyone behind Xie Xuan. He didn't find Bai Ze, and pouted his pink lips with some disappointment, and said, "Didn't Bai Ze come back with you?"
"He has to do something for me, and he probably won't be back until it snows." Xie Xuan carried the wine gourd, took a sip of the green ant wine from Fulai Tavern in Machi Town, and said, "How about it? Do you want to learn?"
"What's there to learn about breathing and breathing?" the little girl asked, tilting her head and moving her braids, which was really cute.
"Once you learn it, you can fly in the clouds." Xie Xuan said, "How about it?"
"Sounds fun!" Caiyun clapped her hands and wrinkled her little nose, "But I have to ask my mother first. If she agrees, I will follow your example!"
"Then go ahead and ask." Xie Xuan walked under the locust tree. Liu Ling had already stood up and personally poured a cup of bitter tea for Xie Xuan.
"Tao Zun." Liu Ling asked, "Where have you been these days?"
